title: The Weekender, Sept. 3-7:Exeter UFO Festival, Cruisin’ Downtown, Levitt Amp free concert series finale + more
description: It's Labor Day Weekend, so the pickings are slim, but there are still plenty of ways to get out and enjoy it! Commemorate the 56th anniversary of the notorious Barney & Betty Hill abduction at the The 2026 Exeter UFO Festival, celebrate a quarter century of cruisin' at the 25th Annual Cruisin' Downtown on Elm Street, sip some fresh java while enjoying the musical stylings of the 2025 Granite Stage first prize winner at Live From the Countertop Presents: Vanessa Hale, or check out Soggy Po Boys at the season finale of the Manchester Music Series in Veterans Park. Don't let the holiday weekend pass you by without making the most of it!
